segments.title: Late Night Helldiving: Operation Democratic Liberation
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors an extended Helldivers 2 gameplay session, learning mechanics with Kendall and coordinating a four-player squad against Automaton forces on medium difficulty.

segments.title: Late Night Helldiving: Pepito Sub Goal Redemption
segments.notes: Executive Producer Pepito fulfills a sub goal by taking the controller, adopting a nonviolent diplomatic approach to Terminid forces, and concluding the broadcast with a raid.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored a marathon Helldivers 2 session, struggled with audio routing and game mechanics before coordinating a full squad.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joined Case for cross-play co-op, provided tactical guidance, and exited mid-session after character death.

lore_notes.fact: Case and Kendall cross-play Helldivers 2 on Steam and PlayStation in the same room.
Pepito claims he is not Case's dog but a friend who received a matching hoodie.
Pepito adopts a nonviolent 'diplomatic' playstyle, attempting to talk to Terminids instead of shooting them.

episode_summary: Lead anchor Case Blackwell conducted an extended off-rundown Helldivers 2 operation, progressing from solo confusion to a coordinated four-person Automaton eradication before yielding the desk to Executive Producer Pepito for a sub-goal redemption stream. Pepito, wearing a matching hoodie and insisting on his status as a freelance canine associate rather than a pet, pursued a diplomatic engagement doctrine with Terminid forces and closed the broadcast with a raid.
